plPadPrinting.title: Pad printing
plPadPrinting.subtitle: Print jobs, ink used from stock, operators and cost per print
plPadPrinting.noCreate: You can see print jobs but not record them. Ask Admin for the production right.

new.title: New print job
new.done: Print job {{doc}} recorded. Ink left the stores into the consumption ledger.

cost.title: Cost per print
cost.formula: Cost per print = (ink value + labour minutes ÷ 60 × labour rate) ÷ (pieces printed × prints per piece)
cost.body: Ink is valued at its lot cost when issued; the labour rate is the one Admin sets on costing. Visible only with "See cost and margin".
